leadStory: Liverpool agreed personal terms with Bradley Barcola and lodged an opening bid near £102.6m, waiting on Paris Saint-Germain, who value the winger closer to £148m.
subject: A single red-shirted winger sprinting along a floodlit stadium touchline toward a bright glow of light ahead of him, seen side-on, mid-stride, arriving
